product.name: VocalDrop
product.tagline: studio-grade acapella, on your own hardware
product.summary: Separates vocals from any track on your own CPU or GPU. Studio-grade results, and your audio never leaves the machine.

press.short: VocalDrop is a free AI vocal isolator and remover for macOS, Windows and Linux that runs entirely on your own hardware.
press.long: VocalDrop separates vocals from instrumentals at studio quality, running the model locally on your own CPU or GPU. No audio ever leaves the machine. It collects anonymous crash and usage diagnostics — never file contents, paths or personal data. Free, with no watermarks, no track limits and no subscription.
press.naming: Written "VocalDrop" — one word, capital V and D. Never "Vocal Drop" or "Vocaldrop".

items.title: Fast and Max models
items.body: The RoFormer model family UVR5 uses, offered at two qualities. Fast for a quick pass, Max when the mix is dense.

items.title: Both stems, one pass
items.body: The isolated vocal and the instrumental land together in the Results feed — separation is one job, not two runs.

items.title: Video too
items.body: Drop a music video or a movie clip; the audio is extracted, separated, and the stem you chose is re-muxed back in sync.

items.title: Fully scriptable
items.body: Everything the app does works from the CLI, with --json output for pipelines. Right-click Quick Actions on macOS into the bargain.

sections.note: Every option the app exposes, with --json for pipelines.

sections.heading: Your audio never leaves the machine
sections.body:
Most free vocal extractors are websites that upload your audio to someone else's server. VocalDrop runs the model locally on your own CPU or GPU, so nothing is sent anywhere, and there is no track limit, watermark or subscription attached to the decision.

It collects anonymous crash and usage diagnostics — never file contents, never paths, never personal data — and that is the whole telemetry story.

items.a: The same RoFormer family UVR5 ships, as a native desktop app — no Python setup, no dependency roulette. Fast and Max presets pick the right configuration per job.
